name: After § 4
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on a united response to recent Russian violations of the EU Member States’ airspace and critical infrastructure
part_text: 4a. Recalls that the Russian shadow fleet is notoriously hard to keep track of due to the constant changing of names and flags, together with unclear and opaque ownership structures; calls, therefore, on the Commission to develop a comprehensive sanctions regime against countries with a proven record of providing flags of convenience to vessels that are linked to the Russian shadow fleet;
